text:
sara: heads-up — master CI is red on macos-amd64, bazel incremental builds failing at link step. clean builds succeed. anyone seen this after the toolchain image roll?

miguel: which target and paste the error?

sara: failing target is //runtime/lib:tokenizer (C++). here's the tail of the link step from CI:
```
ld: undefined symbol: __ZTVN10__cxxabiv120__si_class_type_infoE
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
Target //runtime/lib:tokenizer up-to-date: 0 actions, 1 input file
ERROR: /workspace/runtime/lib/BUILD:24:1 Linking of rule '//runtime/lib:tokenizer' failed (Exit 1): cc_wrapper.sh failed: error executing command
```

ci-bot: Log attached: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/87921/steps/link/tokenizer/console

anya: interesting that clean builds pass. that smells like an incremental cache/LTO mismatch with the new toolchain image. did the image bump also change ld/clang/lto flags?

chris: @sara can you repro locally with incremental build? i.e. build, edit a header minimally, then build again. if clean passes but incremental fails that's almost certainly cache/state related. also try `bazel build --action_env=LD=clang --spawn_strategy=standalone` to force link shim differences.

sara: repro steps:
1) git checkout master @ CI
2) bazel build //runtime/lib:tokenizer  (passes)
3) touch runtime/lib/tokenizer.h
4) bazel build //runtime/lib:tokenizer  (fails at link step, same as CI)

miguel: ok thanks. can you try `bazel clean --expunge` then repeat (you said clean passes) — can you also try building with `--noexperimental_thin_lto`? toolchain might ship with thinlto enabled by default.

sara: quick try: `bazel build //runtime/lib:tokenizer --copt=-fno-lto` — incremental still fails. clean with expunge then build succeeds. so issue only when using existing incremental cache.

anya: that really points to a mismatch between object files produced by previous compiler and new link-time expectations. CI had a toolchain-image roll yesterday: image tag toolchain:v2026-03-15 -> toolchain:v2026-03-22. can eng-infra confirm what changed (clang version / lld / c++abi)?

chris: i'm looking into the image diff now. preliminary: bumped clang 15.1 -> 15.3 and updated lld which changes some mangling/abi details for LTO. sequence: if artifacts built with old lto info get incrementally reused, the new linker can stumble. short-term mitigation: pin toolchain image in CI for macos pool to previous sha, or force a full clean between image changes.

miguel: for triage we can also add a CI job that runs incremental builds specifically (fast path) to detect these regressions earlier. but we need a fix now. @eng-infra (chris) can you do a quick rollback of the macos toolchain image or flip an env var that disables thin lto in CI?

chris: i can push a temporary pin in the macOS pool config to revert to sha d4f7a2b for now. doing that in 5. will also add a note to the release roll PR.

sara: thanks. i'll open a follow-up to add `bazel clean --expunge` step to the image-roll job so we don't get stuck mid-roll. also filing an issue to improve our post-roll smoke tests.

ci-bot: CI config change created: https://infra/internal/changes/3221 — pinned macos toolchain to d4f7a2b (revert image bump).

anya: for longer term, we should add a toolchain compatibility test that runs incremental builds across image boundaries. adding to infra backlog.

miguel: one more note — if anyone needs a quick local workaround: `bazel build --distinct_host_configuration=false`? maybe not ideal. best is expunge.

sara: confirmed: after infra pin, master CI green on macos pool. thanks @chris! :tada:

chris: np — follow-up action items: 1) add expunge to image-roll smoke 2) add incremental-compat test 3) document LTO gotchas in eng-infra runbook. i'll create PRs.

sara: assigning follow-ups in the thread issue: https://boards.internal/redwood/issue/INFRA-1289

miguel: closing the loop — if this recurs i'll run an artifact-level bisect (build old toolchain -> small change -> build new toolchain) to pin exact offending change.

ci-bot: thread archived into INFRA-1289 after 4 messages
